title: IT’S NOT OVER, God Is Not Done With You Yet (Best Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: I know times are tough the pandemic job losses broken relationships and so many different challenges I see the weight many of you are carrying how many of you have felt discouraged recently how many of you are questioning whether God is still with you but I am here today to lift your spirits and tell you something incredibly important it's not over God is not done with you I am also going to pray a powerful prayer with you you in the mighty name

of Jesus so watch until the end and open your hearts to receive the blessings of this prayer my friends the enemy wants you to believe that you've reached the end of the road that there's no hope left for you but I've got news for you today you're not at the end you're merely in the middle the middle of a story that is still being written A Narrative of Grace and Redemption that God himself is crafting for you so don't fold your

hands just yet don't hang your head and defeat God is still in the business of Miracles and he's got one with your name on it and I believe that I'm talking about a miracle so big so incredible that you can't help but say look at What the Lord Has Done For a Moment I want you to think about your favorite book or movie now imagine if you had judged the whole story just by reading the first chapter or watching the first

10 minutes you would have missed the triumphs the resolutions and the plot twists essentially you would have missed the entire Journey that would have made the story worth reading or watching just like those stories our lives are also comprised of chapters some are good and some are tough whether you're currently facing a challenging time or not it's it's crucial to understand that such times will either arrive or are already present in your life they are inevitable they are just a part

of life and that's why what I'm about to share with you will Empower you to overcome these difficult chapters whether they're looming on the horizon or whether you're in the midst of them right now you need to understand the power of incomplete stories this lies in the understanding that God is still writing our life's narrative no matter the setbacks or hardships we may face now let's talk about Joseph the dreamer the Visionary the one who found himself in some very tough

chapters the story of Joseph as mentioned in Genesis 50:20 is a Monumental lesson for us the scripture says but as for you you meant evil against me but God meant it for good Joseph went from being thrown into a pit by his own Brothers to interpreting Pharaoh's dreams in the palace imagine the nights Joseph Must Have Spent wondering what he did to deserve such a fate would you have thought your life was over he could have but he didn't the thing

is Joseph understood something crucial he understood that his story wasn't over when you're in a pit whether literally or metaphorically it's easy to think that's all there is we've all been there maybe you get a bad Health diagnosis or you lose a job or a relationship you valued ends suddenly you're in your pit and it's easy to feel that this chapter is the only chapter of your life but remember this a chapter is not the whole book as you have heard

me say before life has many chapters your current circumstance Es are just one part of a long journey designed by God this concept is vital because when you think it's the end you close yourself off to Opportunities For Change you close the book and you say that's it it's over but what if you're just in the middle of your story what if the climax Is Yet To Come what if your pit is your preparation Joseph didn't go from the pit to

the Palace overnight there were years in between yet years of serving years of imprisonment years of waiting those years were not wasted God was writing Joseph story setting the stage for something greater temporary setbacks are not permanent failures yes you may feel like you've been set back in your life perhaps you dropped out of school maybe you lost a job you loved or a relationship ended and you're in your pit thinking it's all over this setback is temporary my friend With

God all things are possible and this setback might be a setup for your comeback and it often is so when you're delayed when you're detoured when you're in hardship remember that God is preparing you for something greater Joseph's time as a servant in Piper's house and as a prisoner were not wasted times they were periods of preparation building his character refining his skills and positioning him for the grand plan that God had for his life it was the same God who

saw Joseph in his pit and in Piper's house who also saw him standing second only to Pharaoh God was writing Joseph's story just as he is writing yours keep the faith your story is far from over we are all God's work in progress continuously being shaped and guided for a divine Divine Purpose now let's look at the life of the Apostle Paul the Bible verse that Rings true to his life is Philippians 1:6 being confident of this very thing that he

who has begun a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ before his transformation Paul was Saul a man who actively persecuted Christians can you imagine yet God chose him to become one of the most influential Apostles in the history of Christianity why because God saw him as a work in progress there no wonder God advises us not to judge others after all what do we really know we can't see the end from the beginning only

God can see that if understanding this doesn't deter us from passing judgment nothing else will none of us are perfect so let's make a conscious effort to stop judging others whenever we're tempted to judge let's remind ourselves of Paul's story and remember that we are not God God is the judge Isaiah 33:22 reminds us for the Lord is our judge the Lord is our lawgiver the Lord is our King he will save us now when we encounter failures setbacks or hardships

we often feel like damaged goods like something no one would want to invest in isn't it incredible that God doesn't see us that way neither should we see ourselves that way when Saul was busy persecuting Christians God was seeing the Apostle Paul the man who would go on to write 13 books of the New Testament God's investment in US doesn't stop the moment we mess up even when Saul was at his worst God was seeing his potential God's grace covers our

past present and future God's grace is sufficient you're probably familiar with the saying Rome wasn't built in a day the same goes for your spiritual life God didn't just snap his fingers and transform Saul into Paul it was a journey this journey is what we call sanctification the process of becoming more like Christ it's an ongoing lifetime process that requires patience discipline and a lot of Grace but guess what God is willing to invest that much into us the Holy Spirit

has an Irreplaceable role in this journey the Holy Spirit isn't just a comforter he's also a counselor a guide and a teacher the Holy Spirit continually Works in US molding and shaping us into the person God wants us to become he prompts us to do what's right convicts us when we're wrong and empowers us to live a Godly life so don't lose hope if you're not where you want to be just yet if God could transform Saul into Paul think about

what he can do in your life your struggles failures and setbacks don't Define you they refine you you're a work in progress a masterpiece that God is still working on so the next time you feel like God has given up on you remember he is far from done it's not over now consider that we need to recognize God in the ordinary as we encounter miracles in everyday life let's turn our attention to Moses Exodus 3: 2:3 tells us and the angel

of the Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire from the midst of a bush so he looked and behold the Bush was burning with fire but the Bush was not consumed so Moses was doing his day-to-day job he was shephered when he stumbled upon a burning bush and not just any burning bush but one that wasn't consumed he was in the middle of an ordinary act when God turned it into a miraculous moment it's easy to think that God

only shows up in the Monumental moments of life but that couldn't be further from the truth God Specializes in turning the ordinary into extraordinary Moses was just a Shepherd doing Shepherd things yet God chose that moment to reveal an extraordinary plan you could be in your own Shepherd moment right now just living your life thinking it's too ordinary for anything sign significant to happen but that's the perfect ground for God to work a miracle don't underestimate the small ways that shows

that God is working in your life perhaps you have had minor blessings you've overlooked like a near Miss accident A stranger's kindness or even an unexpected phone call from an old friend when you were feeling lonely these are not coincidences these are like micro Miracles these seemingly small inter ventions are like God saying to you I'm here I'm with you in the big and the Small Miracles often start as simple acts of obedience Moses could have ignored the burning bush he

could have thought it was too weird or frightening but his curiosity and obedience led him to a life-altering and history changing Revelation never underestimate the power of simple acts of obedience to God's voice by answering Yes to God in a seemingly trivial matter it could be the key to unlocking a miracle in your life my friends the miraculous is all around you but sometimes you're so caught up looking for big signs and wonders that you miss out on the Miracles that

are already happening in your life the job you have the family that loves you the meal you ate today these are all miracles they may not look like a burning bush but they are evidence that God is working in your life so the next time you find yourself thinking that your life is just a series of monotonous events remember Moses in the burning bush remember that God often uses ordinary settings for Extraordinary purposes it's also important to embrace Divine detours as

they often lead us to unexpected blessings and opportunities for growth this point brings us to Jonah as you know Jonah tried to run away from God's call to go to Nineveh and ended up in the belly of a big fish Jonah 2:9 says but I will sacrifice to you with the voice of Thanksgiving I will pay what I have vowed salvation is of the Lord sometimes God reroutes us to bring us to a purpose we couldn't have foreseen what we see

as a detour God sees as a Divine Direction that's why I don't complain about traffic detours because I know that my steps are ordered by the Lord and I encourage you to adopt the same perspective sometimes we complain too much when in fact we should be giving thanks to God for the guidance and redirection that he brings into our lives then sometimes we all have our nevez the places we don't want to go the jobs we don't want to take the

people we don't want to forgive we run away from them thinking we know better than God eventually when our plans get thwarted we feel disappointed and maybe even angry but what if that detour was God saying I have something better what if God is redirecting you towards a blessing you can't yet see did you ever think about that when God says no it is often a knock yet or sometimes he is saying I have something better think about it Jonah in

Nineveh was not a coincidence it was a Divine appointment sure the path there was uncomfortable I mean who wants to be in the belly of a fish but it led him to God's plan for his life and the lives of the people in Nineveh the next time a door closes in your life before you me think about this maybe it's God redirecting you towards something so much better maybe it's a Divine detour so when your plans go off course take a

moment to thank God for the detours you might not understand it now but one day you will one day you'll look back and realize that the job you didn't get would have been terrible for you or that the relationship you mourned was not the one God intended for you or even that the delay you experienced saved you from an accident God's ways are higher than our ways his detours are Divine directions also consider this your value is not defined by your

circumstances but by how God sees you let's look at the parable of the prodical son Luke 15:32 says it was right that we should make Merry and be glad for your brother was dead and is alive again and was lost and is found this Parable tells us that no matter how far we stray our value in God's eyes remains constant God loves you even when you feel unlovable even when the world has written you off as a failure or a lost

cause God is saying you're mine and you always will be you are not what happened to you you are what God says you are sometimes it's hard to believe that especially when you're feeling low you might think I've messed up too many times God couldn't possibly love me but here's the thing God loves you not because of what you've done or haven't done but because you are his you could be in the lowest point of your life feeling like The Prodigal

Son eating pig slop but in God's eyes you're still worth running toward worth celebrating worth loving what a mighty God we serve his grace is truly sufficient and understand this God is more interested in your future than your past your history does not dictate your destiny if anyone understood this it was the prodigal son he squandered his inheritance and yet his father welcomed him back with open arms why because his value wasn't tied to his circumstances it was tied to his

identity as a beloved Son the same goes for you today God is not done with you no matter your past my friends always remember this your story is still being written you are God's work in progress Miracles often happen when you least expect them Divine detours are often blessings and disguise and your value is not to defined by your circumstances but by God's love whether you are in pits prisons or palaces wherever you are God is there with you writing your

story for his glory and if you remember nothing else today remember this God is not done with you it's not over until God says it's over now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God heavenly father almighty God you are the alpha and the Omega

worthy of all honor glory and praise Lord I am grateful for your Amazing Grace and everlasting love for us I come before you with a humble heart asking for forgiveness for my sins and shortcomings cleanse me oh God and renew a strong and unwavering Spirit within me I am thankful that your grace is sufficient thank you Father for being my everpresent help in times of need I declare in the name of Jesus that the story of my life is far from

over I rebuke the spirit of discouragement ment defeat depression fear anxiety and despair in the name of Jesus I command every demonic influence that may be trying to cloud my vision to be broken in jesus' Name Lord steer me away from Temptation and destructive habits that may be leading me astray and guide me back to the path you have ordained for me Lord may you open doors for opportunity blessings and spiritual growth in my life Lord I ask you to bless

me with your peace and wisdom I thank you Lord for the Divine detours and redirections that keeps me on the path you have planned for me father I come against generational curses as I ask for your divine intervention to break every chain that hinders me and my loved ones Lord I ask for your protection healing and Abundant Blessings In Our Lives surround us with your loving arms guard us from harm and fill our lives with joy and prosperity father I thank

you for the presence of the Holy Spirit as my comforter teacher and for empowering me to live a Godly life Lord as I say this prayer together with everyone listening I I thank you for all the hearts that are humbled before you right now Lord we come into agreement asking for healing in our bodies minds and Spirits father help us to make your truth become alive in us that we may not just be hearers of the word but doers as well

may you fill our hearts with the assurance that no matter where we are right now you are not done with us we deare in the name of Jesus that every unfinished story in our lives will have a god ordained conclusion we refuse to be held back by past failures and we claim your promises for a future filled with hope and purpose Lord may your Holy Spirit help us to be a living testimony to your continuous work in our lives thank you

Lord for hearing and answering my prayer in the name of Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comments section below I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member who you know needs the blessing of this prayer and

by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all those who support us you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comment section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory also we invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right

now and we want you to know that even if you don't see a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that you were not prayed for rest assured that we are actively lifting up each request to God that is in accordance with his will we believe in the power of prayer to bring Comfort healing and guidance in accordance with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we we pray to God be all the glory May the grace and
peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
